Linh T.: quick RFC follow-up: propose a lightweight hybrid consensus for automatic rollbacks. goal: stop flip-flop and reduce SPoF. short sketch below.
Maya P.: curious which signals you consider non-negotiable for auto action?
Alex R.: keep it tiny: 5xx rate, p95 latency, infra-failures. model-quality = advisory unless paired.
Linh T.: hybrid idea: local proxies compute S_local; central aggregator computes S_global. auto-pause only if (S_local>t_local AND S_global>t_global) OR S_global>hard_cutoff. smoothing: exp alpha=0.3, min_samples=3, hold_time=60s.
Sasha K.: +1 to signal schema: each signal = name|type(trigger|advisory)|confidence|sample_rate|version. makes ingestion testable.
Frank O.: ops concern: what if aggregator is down? local proxies should be able to take conservative action in 'degraded' mode but require manual review. add explicit kill-switch.
ops-bot: current sample rates: metrics=1%, quality-evals=0.25%.
Linh T.: example ingestion line: ```{"signal_name":"p95_latency_ms","type":"trigger","value":310.0,"confidence":0.95,"sample_rate":0.01,"schema_version":"1"}```
Alex R.: test plan: replay last 30m in dry-run to validate thresholds and ensure explainable traces.
Maya P.: product note: user-visible regressions are slow; auto actions need coupling with infra/latency. otherwise advisory paging to SRE.
Linh T.: rollout plan: proto aggregator + proxies in shadow 2w, schema+harness 1w, ops runbook+kill-switch 1w, then 2-week shadow with audit logs before enabling automated pauses.
deploy-bot: shadow event recorded: canary:c-99 circuit_score=0.74 -> recommendation (not executed).
Alex R.: looks good. please include dashboard panels showing S, components, smoothing window, and 'why-paused' links.
Linh T.: will open PR with proto config, schema, and checklist.
